single-arm-lat-pulldown.setup: Sit at a cable station with a single handle on the high pulley and your thighs secured under the pads.
steps: Grab the handle with one hand and lean back slightly with a tall chest.
Pull your elbow down and in toward your hip until your hand reaches shoulder level.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly until your lat is fully stretched.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
mistakes: Leaning back and swinging to pull the weight
Shrugging the shoulder up toward your ear
single-arm-lat-pulldown.breathing: Breathe out as you pull down, in as the arm rises.

straight-arm-pulldown.setup: Stand facing a high cable with a straight bar or rope, hips slightly back and a small bend in the knees.
steps: Hold the bar at shoulder height with arms nearly straight and a flat back.
Keeping arms almost straight, sweep the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom for a second.
Let the bar rise slowly until you feel a stretch under your armpits.
mistakes: Bending the elbows and turning it into a triceps pushdown
Using body momentum to move the weight
straight-arm-pulldown.breathing: Breathe out as the bar sweeps down, in as it rises.

machine-pullover.setup: Sit in the pullover machine, adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivot, and rest your elbows on the pads.
steps: Sit back with your upper back against the pad and grip the handles or pads.
Drive your elbows down and forward in an arc until the bar nears your waist.
Squeeze your lats briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start for a full stretch overhead.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the stretched position
Letting the weight stack slam at the top
machine-pullover.breathing: Breathe out as you pull down, in as you return.

face-pull.setup: Set a rope on a cable at about face height, grab each end with palms facing in, and step back until the cable is taut.
steps: Stand tall with arms straight, feet shoulder-width, and a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends apart beside your ears.
Keep elbows high, squeeze your shoulder blades, and pause.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
mistakes: Going too heavy and leaning back to yank it
Letting elbows drop so it becomes a row
face-pull.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

barbell-shrug.setup: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip just outside your hips.
steps: Stand tall with arms straight and shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as you can.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower slowly until your shoulders are fully relaxed.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles
Bending the elbows to help lift the bar
barbell-shrug.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

dumbbell-shrug.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your body.
steps: Stand tall with arms straight and chest up.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower slowly until your shoulders fully drop.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders
Using a weight so heavy the range is tiny
dumbbell-shrug.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

trap-bar-shrug.setup: Stand inside a trap bar and lift it using the handles with a flat back, then stand tall holding it at your sides.
steps: Stand tall with the trap bar at your sides, arms straight.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly to a full shoulder drop.
mistakes: Bending the elbows to lift the weight
Leaning forward or back during the rep
trap-bar-shrug.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

prone-y-raise.setup: Lie face down on a bench set at a slight incline or on the floor, holding light dumbbells with arms hanging down.
steps: Lie face down with your forehead off the bench and arms hanging.
Raise both arms forward and up in a Y shape, thumbs pointing up.
Pause when your arms are in line with your body.
Lower slowly back to the start.
cues: Thumbs up, arms in a Y
mistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging the arms
Lifting the head or arching the lower back
prone-y-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

back-extension.setup: Set up on a back extension bench with your hips just over the pad and your heels hooked under the rollers.
steps: Cross your arms on your chest and start with your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips with a flat back.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.
mistakes: Over-arching the lower back past a straight line
Using fast, swinging momentum
back-extension.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

reverse-hyperextension.setup: Lie face down on a reverse hyper machine with your hips at the edge of the pad and your hands gripping the handles.
steps: Hold the handles with legs hanging down and straight.
Raise your legs behind you until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower slowly and let the legs swing only slightly under the pad.
mistakes: Kicking up past hip level and over-arching the back
Using momentum from the swing at the bottom
reverse-hyperextension.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

good-morning.setup: Stand with a barbell on your upper back, feet shoulder-width, and knees slightly bent.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest up with the bar secure on your traps.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower until your torso is near parallel or you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back
Squatting down instead of hinging
good-morning.breathing: Breathe in and brace on the way down, out as you stand.

superman.setup: Lie face down on a mat with arms extended in front of you and legs straight.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and lower back to lift arms, chest, and legs slightly off the floor.
Hold the top position for 2 seconds.
Lower slowly back to the mat.
Repeat without resting your limbs on the floor.
mistakes: Lifting too high and crunching the neck
Jerking up with momentum
superman.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

bird-dog.setup: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
steps: Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back at the same time.
Hold for 2 seconds in line with your torso.
Return slowly and switch sides.
mistakes: Arching the lower back and lifting the leg too high
Letting hips rotate or sway
bird-dog.breathing: Breathe out as you extend, in as you return.

renegade-row.setup: Start in a plank position with each hand gripping a dumbbell on the floor, feet wide for balance.
steps: Brace your abs and glutes in a strong plank with hands on the dumbbells.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs while keeping your hips still.
Lower it under control to the floor.
Row the other side and keep alternating.
mistakes: Twisting the hips open as you row
Using dumbbells too heavy to keep the plank
renegade-row.breathing: Breathe out as you row, in as you lower.

overhead-press.setup: Stand with a barbell racked at upper chest height, hands just outside shoulders, and feet hip-width.
steps: Unrack the bar, brace your core, and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out with the bar over your mid-foot and biceps by your ears.
Lower the bar under control to your upper chest.
mistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press
Flaring the ribs and over-arching the lower back
overhead-press.breathing: Breathe in and brace before pressing, out at lockout.

seated-barbell-shoulder-press.setup: Sit on a bench with back support set upright and a barbell racked at about upper chest height.
steps: Unrack the bar with hands just outside shoulder width and brace your core.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly overhead.
Lower the bar under control to your upper chest.
mistakes: Over-arching the back to push the bar up
Lowering the bar too fast to the chest
seated-barbell-shoulder-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

push-press.setup: Stand with a barbell racked on your front shoulders, hands just outside shoulders, and feet hip-width.
steps: Unrack the bar and keep elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few centimetres by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead in one motion.
Lock out, then lower the bar to your shoulders and absorb with the knees.
mistakes: Leaning back instead of dipping straight down
Pausing between the leg drive and the press
push-press.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, then out at lockout.

behind-the-neck-press.setup: Sit or stand with a barbell resting on your upper back and hands wide enough that forearms stay vertical.
steps: Set the bar on your upper traps and brace your core with your head neutral.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are locked out.
Lower the bar only to ear level, not onto your neck.
Use light weights and stop if your shoulders feel pinched.
mistakes: Lowering the bar too far and straining the shoulders
Using a grip that is too narrow
behind-the-neck-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press.setup: Sit on an upright bench holding a dumbbell at each shoulder with palms facing forward.
steps: Keep your back on the pad and brace your core.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top without clanging the weights.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad
Lowering the dumbbells too fast or too low
seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

standing-dumbbell-shoulder-press.setup: Stand with feet hip-width holding a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms facing forward.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to your shoulders.
mistakes: Leaning back and over-arching the lower back
Using leg drive when you want a strict press
standing-dumbbell-shoulder-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

arnold-press.setup: Sit on an upright bench holding dumbbells at chest height with palms facing you.
steps: Start with elbows in front of you and palms facing your body.
Press the dumbbells up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Finish with arms straight overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to your chest.
mistakes: Rushing the rotation with swinging momentum
Arching the lower back at the top
arnold-press.breathing: Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.

single-arm-dumbbell-press.setup: Stand or sit holding one dumbbell at your shoulder, with your free hand on your hip or a support.
steps: Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight.
Pause briefly overhead.
Lower under control to your shoulder, then switch arms.
mistakes: Leaning sideways to push the weight up
Letting the elbow flare far behind the body
single-arm-dumbbell-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

machine-shoulder-press.setup: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
steps: Grip the handles and keep your back against the pad.
Press the handles up until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until your hands are near shoulder height.
mistakes: Setting the seat too low or too high
Shrugging the shoulders up to your ears
machine-shoulder-press.breathing: Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.

smith-machine-shoulder-press.setup: Sit on a bench inside a Smith machine with the bar at about chin height and feet flat on the floor.
steps: Grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unhook it.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower to chin level, then rehook the bar when finished.
mistakes: Placing the bench too far forward or back
Bouncing the bar off your chest
smith-machine-shoulder-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

z-press.setup: Sit on the floor with legs straight out in front of you and a barbell racked or held at your shoulders.
steps: Sit tall with your legs wide and the bar at your upper chest.
Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are locked out.
Lower under control back to your upper chest.
mistakes: Leaning back to push the bar up
Rounding the lower back while seated
z-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

pike-push-up.setup: Start in a pike position with hands shoulder-width apart, feet back, and hips high so your body makes an upside-down V.
steps: Walk your feet toward your hands so your hips are high.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Stop before your head touches down.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare wide
Dropping the hips and doing a regular push-up
pike-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

handstand-push-up.setup: Kick up into a handstand with your back or chest facing a wall, hands shoulder-width, on a mat.
steps: Brace your abs and glutes in a stable handstand against the wall.
Lower your head slowly toward the floor with elbows about 45 degrees.
Lightly touch your head to a pad or the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight. Use a spotter if you are new.
mistakes: Dropping fast and bouncing off the head
Arching the back heavily against the wall
handstand-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

dumbbell-lateral-raise.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
steps: Stand tall with your chest up and core braced.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly with your elbows slightly higher than your hands.
Lower slowly back to your sides.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weights
Shrugging shoulders up toward the ears
dumbbell-lateral-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

cable-lateral-raise.setup: Stand sideways to a low cable with the handle in the hand farthest from the machine.
steps: Hold the handle across your body with a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back across your body.
mistakes: Leaning away and using body swing
Raising the hand above shoulder height
cable-lateral-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

machine-lateral-raise.setup: Sit in the lateral raise machine with your arms against the pads and the seat set so the pivot lines up with your shoulders.
steps: Sit tall with your back against the pad and elbows resting on the arm pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
mistakes: Setting the seat so the pivot is not at your shoulder
Using momentum and jerking the weight
machine-lateral-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

lean-away-lateral-raise.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand and grip an upright or rack with the other, leaning your body away from it.
steps: Hold the support and lean away with your body in a straight line.
Raise the free arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
mistakes: Bending at the waist rather than leaning as one piece
Using a weight that is too heavy
lean-away-lateral-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

upright-row.setup: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
steps: Stand tall and brace your core.
Pull the bar up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows reach about shoulder height.
Lower slowly. Stop if your shoulders pinch.
mistakes: Pulling the bar higher than the chest
Using a narrow grip that irritates the shoulders
upright-row.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

cable-upright-row.setup: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar or rope attached, holding it in front of your thighs.
steps: Stand tall with arms straight and core braced.
Pull the handle up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows reach about shoulder height.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Keep it close to the body
mistakes: Pulling the handle too high
Leaning back to jerk the weight up
cable-upright-row.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

dumbbell-front-raise.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs with palms facing your body.
steps: Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one or both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to your thighs.
mistakes: Swinging the weights using your back
Raising the weights above shoulder height
dumbbell-front-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

plate-front-raise.setup: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions in front of your thighs.
steps: Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the plate in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to your thighs.
mistakes: Leaning back and swinging the plate up
Gripping the plate too heavy for your shoulders
plate-front-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

cable-front-raise.setup: Stand facing away from a low cable with the handle in one hand, between your legs, and step forward to tension the cable.
steps: Brace your core and hold the handle at your thigh with a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arm straight in front to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
mistakes: Using body swing to move the handle
Raising the arm too high
cable-front-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

rear-delt-fly-dumbbell.setup: Stand holding light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, arms hanging down.
steps: Hinge forward until your torso is near parallel to the floor.
Raise the dumbbells out to your sides with a slight elbow bend.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
mistakes: Using momentum and swinging the torso
Pulling the weights with the traps and shrugging
rear-delt-fly-dumbbell.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

reverse-pec-deck.setup: Sit facing the pad on a pec deck machine, chest against it, with handles at arm's length and the seat set to shoulder height.
steps: Grab the handles with a slight elbow bend and keep your chest on the pad.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your rear shoulders at the end.
Return slowly under control.
mistakes: Pulling back with the arms and overusing the traps
Letting the weights slam together
reverse-pec-deck.breathing: Breathe out as you open, in as you return.

cable-rear-delt-fly.setup: Stand between two high cables, holding the opposite handles in each hand, with arms crossed in front of you.
steps: Stand with a slight bend in the knees and hold the opposite handles.
Pull your arms apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your rear shoulders at the end.
Return slowly to the crossed position.
mistakes: Using body momentum to jerk the handles
Pulling too low and turning it into a row
cable-rear-delt-fly.breathing: Breathe out as you open, in as you return.

band-pull-apart.setup: Stand tall holding a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height, hands shoulder-width apart.
steps: Hold the band with straight arms in front of your chest.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly with control.
mistakes: Shrugging shoulders up toward the ears
Leaning back to cheat the pull
band-pull-apart.breathing: Breathe out as you pull apart, in as you return.

external-rotation-cable.setup: Stand sideways to a cable at elbow height, holding the handle with the hand farthest from the machine and your elbow tucked to your side.
steps: Tuck a small towel between your elbow and ribs.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees with the handle across your belly.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly, keeping the elbow in place.
Return slowly under control. Use light weight.
mistakes: Letting the elbow drift away from the side
Using too heavy a weight and twisting the torso
external-rotation-cable.breathing: Breathe out as you rotate out, in as you return.

side-lying-external-rotation.setup: Lie on your side with a light dumbbell in your top hand and your elbow bent to 90 degrees against your ribs.
steps: Place a rolled towel between your elbow and ribs.
Hold the dumbbell with the forearm resting across your belly.
Rotate your forearm upward toward the ceiling, keeping the elbow in place.
Lower slowly under control. Use very light weight.
mistakes: Lifting the elbow away from the body
Using heavy weights and jerking
side-lying-external-rotation.breathing: Breathe out as you rotate up, in as you lower.

internal-rotation-cable.setup: Stand sideways to a cable at elbow height, holding the handle with the hand nearest the machine and your elbow tucked to your side.
steps: Tuck a small towel between your elbow and ribs.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees with the forearm pointing outward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly, keeping the elbow in place.
Return slowly under control. Use light weight.
mistakes: Letting the elbow drift away from the side
Rotating the whole torso instead of the arm
internal-rotation-cable.breathing: Breathe out as you rotate in, in as you return.

cuban-press.setup: Stand holding light dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing your body.
steps: Pull the dumbbells up to chest height with elbows high, as in an upright row.
Rotate your forearms upward until your hands are above your elbows.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Reverse the steps to lower. Use very light weights.
mistakes: Using heavy weights and rushing the rotation
Letting the elbows drop during the rotation
cuban-press.breathing: Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.

full-can-raise.setup: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides with thumbs pointing up, like holding a full can.
steps: Stand tall with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms diagonally forward at about 30 degrees from straight ahead, thumbs up.
Stop at shoulder height and pause.
Lower slowly. Use light weights.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders during the raise
Swinging the weights with the lower back
full-can-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise, in as you lower.

overhead-plate-halo.setup: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at chest height in front of you, feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Brace your abs and stand tall with the plate close to your chin.
Circle the plate slowly around your head, keeping it close.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Reverse direction on the next rep.
mistakes: Leaning back and arching the lower back
Using a plate so heavy it pulls you off balance
overhead-plate-halo.breathing: Breathe steadily throughout; do not hold your breath.

barbell-curl.setup: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width, arms hanging in front of your thighs.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows forward.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the bar
Letting the elbows drift forward
barbell-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

ez-bar-curl.setup: Stand holding an EZ-bar on its angled grips with an underhand grip and arms hanging in front of your thighs.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Swinging the torso to get the bar up
Dropping the weight fast on the way down
ez-bar-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

dumbbell-curl.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing forward.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weights
Letting the elbows drift forward
dumbbell-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

incline-dumbbell-curl.setup: Sit back on an incline bench set to about 45 degrees, holding dumbbells with arms hanging straight down behind your torso.
steps: Keep your back and head against the bench.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight for a full stretch.
cues: Feel the stretch at the bottom
mistakes: Letting the elbows swing forward
Using a heavy weight that cuts the range short
incline-dumbbell-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

hammer-curl.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing your thighs.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Curl the dumbbells up with palms facing each other, as if holding hammers.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weights
Rotating the wrists during the rep
hammer-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

cross-body-hammer-curl.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing your thighs.
steps: Stand tall with your elbows tucked in.
Curl one dumbbell diagonally across your body toward the opposite shoulder, palm facing in.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and alternate arms.
cues: Keep the elbow at your side
mistakes: Swinging the torso to get the dumbbell up
Letting the elbow drift forward
cross-body-hammer-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

preacher-curl.setup: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad and an EZ-bar held with an underhand grip.
steps: Rest your upper arms flat on the pad and hold the bar.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost fully straight.
cues: Upper arms stay on the pad
Do not fully lock the elbows
mistakes: Dropping the bar fast at the bottom, risking the elbow
Lifting the elbows or hips off the bench
preacher-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

machine-preacher-curl.setup: Sit at the preacher curl machine with your upper arms on the pad and the seat set so the pad is at your armpits.
steps: Rest your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
cues: Upper arms stay on the pad
Do not lock the elbows hard
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad
Letting the weights drop at the bottom
machine-preacher-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

spider-curl.setup: Lie chest down on an incline bench set to about 45 degrees with dumbbells hanging straight down.
steps: Rest your chest on the bench with arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Swinging the arms back to get momentum
Lifting the chest off the bench
spider-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

concentration-curl.setup: Sit on a bench with your feet wide, holding a dumbbell and resting your elbow against the inside of your thigh.
steps: Rest your elbow on your inner thigh with the arm hanging straight.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight. Switch arms.
mistakes: Leaning back and swinging the weight
Lifting the elbow off the thigh
concentration-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

cable-curl.setup: Stand facing a low cable with a straight or EZ-bar attached, holding it with an underhand grip.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Leaning back and swinging the weight
Letting the elbows drift forward
cable-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

bayesian-cable-curl.setup: Stand facing away from a low cable, holding the handle in one hand with your arm behind your body and a staggered stance.
steps: Step forward to put tension on the cable with your arm behind you.
Keep your elbow slightly behind your body.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly for a full stretch. Switch arms.
mistakes: Letting the elbow swing forward
Leaning forward to get the handle up
bayesian-cable-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

reverse-curl.setup: Stand holding an EZ-bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, arms in front of your thighs.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting the wrists bend back
Swinging the body to lift the bar
reverse-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

zottman-curl.setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing forward.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Curl the dumbbells up with palms facing forward.
Rotate your palms to face down at the top.
Lower slowly with palms down, then rotate back to start.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weights
Using a heavy weight that you cannot lower slowly
zottman-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

drag-curl.setup: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width, arms hanging in front of your thighs.
steps: Stand tall and keep the bar close to your body.
Pull your elbows back and curl the bar up, dragging it along your torso.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
mistakes: Letting the bar swing away from the body
Leaning back to lift the bar
drag-curl.breathing: Breathe out as you lift or pull, and in as you lower.

chin-up-hold.setup: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
steps: Use a box or jump to get your chin above the bar.
Hold with elbows bent and chin above the bar.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
Lower slowly when you tire. Use a box or band if needed.
mistakes: Craning the neck to get the chin over
Dropping fast when you tire
chin-up-hold.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

triceps-pushdown-rope.setup: Stand facing a high cable with a rope attached, holding both ends with palms facing in and elbows at your sides.
steps: Stand tall with elbows tucked beside your ribs.
Push the rope down until your arms are fully straight.
Spread the rope ends apart at the bottom and squeeze.
Let the rope rise slowly until your forearms are just past parallel.
cues: Spread the rope at the bottom
mistakes: Leaning over the rope and using body weight
Letting the elbows flare out
triceps-pushdown-rope.breathing: Breathe out as you push down, in as you return.
